description: The technology each brand runs, per brand: e-commerce platform first, then payments, cross-border, email/SMS, reviews and loyalty, search and personalisation, customer service, shipping, analytics, advertising, consent/security and infrastructure, each with its category names. Social networks the site links to are listed apart (a profile link is not a tool the store runs). Up to 40 technologies per brand by default (max_per_brand up to 200); the count left out is stated per brand.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

max_per_brand.description: Technologies listed per brand (default 40). The rest are counted, not listed.
